task:
A Shotcut project exists at /home/user/Documents/travel.mlt with 1280x720 resolution and 25 fps. A video file beach.mp4 is located at /home/user/Videos/beach.mp4.

Actions required:
1. Add beach.mp4 to the project.
2. Place beach.mp4 on the V1 timeline track as the only clip.
3. Save the project.

The saved travel.mlt must maintain the 1280x720 25 fps profile and contain a single clip referencing beach.mp4.

verification.description: Clip beach.mp4 is referenced in the project

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CLI: project open travel.mlt, timeline add-clip beach.mp4 --track 1, project save
cli_feasibility.reason: ✅ Fully supported by CLI-Anything shotcut skills: project open, timeline add-clip, project save. Simple single-clip addition workflow.
